rules.pattern: \A[ \t]{0,4}(?:In (?:this|the present) (?:trial|study), )?baseline characteristics were generally well[- ]balanced between the (?:two )?(?:treatment |intervention |randomi[sz]ed )?groups(?: \(Table [1-9][0-9]{0,2} ?\))?\.?[ \t]{0,4}\Z
rules.rationale: The qualified statement of overall baseline balance supports PN for evidence of a randomisation problem, independently of the outcome. Whole-sentence matching excludes qualifications and other-trial attributions. This interpretation follows the baseline-evidence distinction in [Cochrane Handbook chapter 8](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
fires_on: Baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups (Table 1 ).
In this trial, baseline characteristics were generally well-balanced between the treatment groups.
must_not_fire_on: Baseline characteristics were not generally well balanced between the two groups (Table 1 ).
In a previous trial, baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups.
Baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups in another trial.
Baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups, except for a major prognostic imbalance.
Baseline characteristics were generally well balanced between the two groups after propensity-score matching.

rules.pattern: \A[ \t]{0,4}(?:In (?:this|the present) (?:trial|study), )?at baseline, the (?!(?:historical|external|previous|prior|other)\b)(?:[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,24}|active treatment) and (?:placebo|control) groups were (?:similar|comparable) with respect to (?:demographic and clinical|clinical and demographic) characteristics(?: \(Table [1-9][0-9]{0,2} ?\))?\.?[ \t]{0,4}\Z
rules.rationale: An unqualified report of baseline similarity covering both demographic and clinical characteristics supports N for baseline differences suggesting a randomisation problem. The pattern requires the baseline-first construction missed by the existing rule and rejects appended exceptions or external-trial attribution.
fires_on: At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics
At baseline, the intervention and control groups were comparable with respect to clinical and demographic characteristics (Table 2).
must_not_fire_on: At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were not similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics.
In a previous trial, at baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics.
At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics in the earlier trial.
At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics, except for disease severity.
At baseline, the LcS and placebo groups were similar with respect to demographic characteristics.
At follow-up, the intervention and control groups were comparable with respect to demographic and clinical characteristics.
